basis: Owner final service answers supplied in this conversation, 2026-10-22

services.admissions: ILMERA reviews a student's eligibility, academic qualifications, English-language evidence and admission criteria.
services.finance: ILMERA guides students on financial requirements, bank accounts and education loan information.
services.scholarships: ILMERA helps students identify scholarships and guides them through applications and required documents, including Italy DSU scholarships.
services.budgets: ILMERA compares tuition fees and living expenses to help students choose study destinations.
services.visa: ILMERA guides students with visa documentation, appointment procedures and refusal-related guidance.
services.documents: ILMERA guides students on obtaining income certificates, MOI letters and other supporting documents.
services.aps: ILMERA guides students through APS requirements and document preparation for Germany.
services.medicine: ILMERA offers counselling for students interested in studying medicine in Russia. Recognition and permission to practise are decided by the responsible authorities.

not_offered: ILMERA does not provide advice on working during study or staying after study.
decisions: Universities, immigration authorities, scholarship bodies, lenders and banks make their own decisions. ILMERA does not decide admissions, visas, scholarships or loans and does not promise outcomes.
finance_limit: Lender selection, loan decisions and account opening remain with the student and the relevant provider. Tax and investment advice are outside ILMERA's scope.
fees: ILMERA has a service-fee and payment policy covering service inclusions and refund terms. Detailed amounts, payment conditions and refund terms are not yet published.
disclosure: ILMERA will disclose any university or partner payment arrangements transparently to families.
founder_role: Jabir KJ is the Founder, responsible for university research, admissions and application guidance.
founder_bio: Jabir KJ is the founder of ILMERA Study Abroad, focused on helping students explore affordable international education opportunities.
